text:
ben: Heads-up — noticed tenants hitting long-tail cold starts even when they have soft reservations. Thinking we might be leaking warmup tokens across our burst/soft-reserve accounting. Anyone seen this?
anya: yup, saw a spike yesterday. traced to prewarm eviction loop where reservation credit decays faster than operator reassigns, so tenant loses slot and the next request cold-starts. :frowning_face: 
sam: quick idea: make prewarm credits sticky for a short window + allow operator to delay eviction for pooled warmups. config sketch: `prewarm_stickiness: 30s`
alex: caution — sticky credits risk hoarding under churn. alt: warmup affinity hints attached to leases; operator can reassign slot but the runtime keeps KV cache keyed by hint until TTL. less resource-hoggy.
ben: both valid. hybrid might work: short stickiness (10–30s) + warm cache keying by tenant+model-version. eviction reassigns slot but KV cache survives until TTL so next pod can reuse.
juhi: note: we already key runtime cache by (tenant_id, model, prefix_hash) but when pod is reclaimed the local KV disappears. to preserve cache we'd need either ephemeral persistence (node-local SSD) or extend pod tear-down grace to stream cache to new owner.
sania: extending graceful shutdown from 5s->30s helps but increases drain tail and could hurt our latency SLOs during scale-down events.
ben: tradeoff matrix: longer drains = less cold-starts but slower scale-down and higher cost. persisting small cache snaps to disk avoids long drains but adds IO complexity.
sam: ops question — who bears node-local SSD I/O and how does this behave under noisy-neighbor writes? also more complexity for private deployments.
anya: alternative routing approach: prefer cold-start-tolerant tenants to best-effort pool and keep reserved pool for strict low-latency tenants. needs richer route signals: per-route `latency_priority` + model-sensitivity hints.
alex: we have basic routing signals but not that fine-grained. adding `latency_priority` with fallback lanes seems doable and low-risk.
ben: proposed action items: 1) infra prototype ephemeral cache snapshot to node-local disk (juhi + sam), 2) runtime change to support tenant+model KV namespace TTL and restore (juhi), 3) planner add short `prewarm_stickiness` and operator override knob (alex), 4) product to spec `latency_priority` per route (anya). I'll open an RFC PR with tradeoffs.
deploy-bot: ben requested to open an RFC: /rfc new 'ephemeral-warm-cache-and-stickiness'
